title: File:Grampians Halls Gap from Pinnacle - Nov 2008.jpg
claims: The photograph looks down from the Pinnacle over Halls Gap: a stepped sandstone cliff and wooded slope occupy the left foreground, the town sits in the valley below, and a reservoir, paddocks, forested ridges and distant plains fill the middle and background; the file page gives the camera location as 37.159752 S, 142.515217 E.

Commons titles the photograph Grampians Halls Gap from Pinnacle - Nov 2008.jpg and describes it as the town of Halls Gap at the foothills of the Grampians; it shows the town and cliff environment, not the GPT100 start, finish, aid station, course marking, timing mat or race-day crowd.

The author is Diliff; the file is licensed CC BY-SA 3.0; the photograph was taken on 2008-11-23; the original is 5,343 x 2,772 pixels and 8,483,405 bytes, and the description records an exposure blend of 36 frames.
The route page uses a 960 x 498 copy of 169,556 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits Diliff, CC BY-SA 3.0, Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
